t: The Brenner Probiotic Drain Cleaner 1Ltr is a preventative maintenance solution designed to keep plumbing systems clear and free-flowing. This product is ideal for plumbers and maintenance teams working in busy commercial kitchens and rental properties to prevent blockages. The probiotic formula actively digests organic waste to control unpleasant odours and prevent build-ups before they cause blockages. Regular application ensures drains remain clean, though it is not suitable for pipes that are already blocked.
b: Digests Organic Waste to Keep Drains Flowing
